primary_justification: Manual review found that the source-only rows are not missing position-level holdings to add. They are shortened borrower/category identifiers such as Commercial Services & Supplies Beeline IQN Holding Corp. and Commercial Services & Supplies Heritage Environmental Services Heritage Environmental Services, Inc. The bundled coordinate evidence and current same-accession holding rows show the actual production positions at a finer grain, including separate loan rows with instrument, spread/floor, maturity, cost, and fair value. Adding the source-only borrower labels would duplicate position exposure and violate the position-level holdings contract.
residual_risk: This verdict clears the reviewed rows for accounting purposes only; it does not implement a general many-to-one source reconciliation rule. A future deterministic rule would need to prove exact borrower-rollup-to-tranche sums across all candidate rows and guard against true single-position rows that happen to have short source identifiers.
